description: Defines an abstract class LeaveAllocate for handling leave allocation events within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties and methods to manage leave request details, workflow state, and performer information.

classes.name: LeaveAllocate
classes.description: An abstract class representing a leave allocation event, encapsulating leave request details, workflow state, and the performer involved.

methods.name: getDetailedLeaveRequest
methods.description: Returns a detailed leave request, converting and fetching leaves if the original leave request is of type LeaveRequest.

methods.name: getWorkflow
methods.description: Returns the workflow state machine associated with the leave allocation event.

methods.name: getPerformer
methods.description: Returns the user who performed the leave allocation event.
